name: Hims & Hers Health, Inc.
blurb: Hims & Hers Health is a telehealth platform that sells branded personal-care and prescription products — hair loss, erectile dysfunction, anxiety, skincare — through a direct-to-consumer subscription model. It became a high-profile case study in pharmaceutical compounding: during the years-long shortage of semaglutide (the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy), the company produced and sold cheaper copycat formulations legally permitted under FDA shortage rules, turning a niche clinical carve-out into a headline growth engine.
recent: The FDA declared semaglutide no longer in shortage in early 2025, effectively terminating the legal basis for Hims's compounded GLP-1 business and triggering a roughly 20% stock drop. The company pivoted: it entered a distribution agreement with Novo Nordisk to sell branded Ozempic directly through its platform (lower-margin but legitimate), acquired an Australian telehealth company, Eucalyptus, for $1.15 billion, and launched a testosterone-therapy product. An SEC investigation into its GLP-1 marketing practices was disclosed in early 2026. Full-year 2025 revenue reached $2.35 billion; the company guided to $2.7–$2.9 billion for 2026.
